notes: The source URL and text are for Moorpark's Electronics Engineering Technology Certificate of Achievement, not for Engineering Computer Aided Design and Drafting. That page prints 'Total Units for Certificate 23-26'. This award is classed as 8 to fewer than 16 units, so the page cannot be this award. No requirements were recorded.

For reviewer reference, the Electronics Engineering Technology page prints three parts. REQUIRED CORE: ENGR M04 3, ENGT M02 3, ENGT M04 3, ENGT M06 3, ENGT M20 3, ENGT M28 2. LIST A (choose one, 3-6 units): MATH M06 3, MATH M07 6, MATH M24 4, MATH C2210 5, MATH C2210H 5. LIST B (choose one, 3 units): ENGT M10 3, ENGT M12 3.
The page's two program student learning outcomes belong to the Electronics Engineering Technology program, so they were not recorded for this award.
The correct catalog page for the Engineering Computer Aided Design and Drafting certificate should be located and read.
